extraction.title: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
extraction.head: monitor-incident-refactor-after

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as extracting incident logic into src/sentry/monitors/logic/incidents.py (try_incident_threshold) and issue occurrence and message logic into incident_occurrence.py, with mark_failed.py delegating to them and a new SimpleCheckIn TypedDict in types.py. Confidence score 3/5, citing possible database race conditions in incidents.py, a context-building bug in incident_occurrence.py, and a lack of concurrency tests.
Syntax comment: the docstring of get_failure_reason misspells 'human' as 'humam' (also 'readible'). A suggested change fixes the spelling.

Logic comment: get_monitor_environment_context uses monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of the modified local config variable, so the schedule_type transformation is discarded. A suggested change returns config instead.
